description: This file contains SCSS mixins for form validation styling, including visual feedback, tooltips, and validation states for form controls such as input, select, textarea, and checkboxes.

methods.name: form-validation-state-selector
methods.description: Mixin that defines CSS for validation state selectors based on input state ('valid' or 'invalid').

methods.name: form-validation-state
methods.description: Mixin that styles form validation feedback, tooltips, and input border colors based on validation state, incorporating icons, colors, shadows, and positioning.
